title: Descent
description: A woman in a yellow jumpsuit numbered 949 is captured mid-air, leaping down a dilapidated spiral staircase while holding a vintage television set that emits light. Below her, shadowy zombie-like figures reach upward from a flooded basement containing two eerie, green-slime-covered paintings, one depicting a religious figure and another a horned demonic creature.
prompt: A dramatic action scene of a woman wearing a yellow jumpsuit with the number 949 on the back, leaping down a decaying spiral staircase inside an abandoned building. She holds an old CRT television in one hand and reaches for the railing with the other. Below, shadowy zombie figures emerge from green water near two framed paintings covered in green slime, one showing a saint and the other a demonic figure. Cinematic lighting with a strong beam from above, dark purple and green color palette, horror atmosphere.
